subject: english-language
sourceName: WJEC Eduqas GCSE English Language specification (from 2015)

units.n: 1. Component 1 — 20th Century Literature Reading and Creative Prose Writing
subs: Section A: Reading — analysis of one 20th-century literature prose extract
Section B: Prose writing — one creative writing task (choice of four)

units.n: 2. Component 2 — 19th and 21st Century Non-Fiction Reading and Transactional/Persuasive Writing
subs: Section A: Reading — analysis of two high-quality non-fiction texts (one 19th-century, one 21st-century)
Section B: Writing — two compulsory transactional/persuasive writing tasks
